params.schedule: bl2012-two-grumpy-giants, reading in predicate: bl2012-fitted-1 or chain-free

statements.informal: For every integer t with 68158464 <= t <= 133169152: l is the smallest prime >= t; n = (n_milli * isqrt(l) + 500) // 1000 with n_milli from the predicate; W(l, n) is the slope-model weight of the two-grumpy-giants schedule under the chain-free reading; a = n / sqrt(l); rho = ((l+1)/2 mod n) / sqrt(l); G_phase(a, rho) is the closed form of DERIVATION.md (SHA256 8abb68923384950fefe09318ab542f0233d176adb7a9ff5a35894a285d3ef6c2), n_milli 564; W >= sum over i >= 0 of max(0, l - i(i+1)/2).
